resources.string: Example: the Allow USB debugging prompt on your phone, with Always allow from this computer unticked.
Connect your phone with the data cable

"1 Unlock your phone, unplug the cable and plug it back in.\n2 Tap Allow on the “Allow USB debugging?” prompt.\n3 No prompt? In Developer options, tap Revoke USB debugging authorizations, then reconnect."
In the extracted source folder on your computer, run:
Connect your phone with a USB data cable
Approve USB debugging on this phone
Leave **Always allow from this computer** unchecked

"• Phone unlocked, USB debugging on
• A data cable, not charge-only
• Android Studio, other ADB tools and setup tabs closed
• Chrome or Edge, not Safari or Firefox"
Approve the capture on the website
Keep the cable in until cleanup finishes.
Read the capture explanation and choose **Start capture**
Select your scooter in NAVEE and connect
After cleanup, choose **Save to phone Downloads**
This file holds your owner key. Keep it private.
"• NAVEE signed in, scooter nearby\n• Other scooter apps closed\n• Stopped early? Finish cleanup in the same browser first"
Pick navee-owner-setup.json. This restores scooter access only, not rides or other app data.
This file unlocks your scooter. Keep it private.
Owner key found, stored privately on this phone. %1$s
Couldn\'t delete · remove it in Files
Volt makes an owner key and keeps it on this phone. A scooter with no owner takes the first key it\'s given.
Never set up, or removed from the NAVEE app
The NAVEE app can\'t add this scooter while it has Volt\'s key. To switch back, release it in Volt first.
This scooter already has an owner, so it refused the new key. Remove it from the NAVEE app and try again, or set up another way.
Volt made this scooter\'s owner key, and it\'s only on this phone. Back up Volt so you can set it up on another phone.
Owner key, 12 characters, or a private backup
